title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics; parity fixes; version bump v1.193.0
author: Aisha Patel
description: This PR unifies the auth/retries implementation across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, improves streaming ergonomics (chunked events + backpressure hooks), fixes several parity gaps, and bumps SDK versions to v1.193.0. Motivation: we have drift between language SDKs that leads to inconsistent retry behavior and streaming ergonomics differences that complicate RN/console integrations. Changes include consolidated retry config (max_attempts, backoff_strategy, retryable_statuses), single source of truth for auth token refresh with a standardized interface, streaming client improvements (chunked event API, reconnect/backpressure hooks), and multiple small parity fixes to match server semantics (error wrapping, metadata propagation). Checklist: - [x] Unify retry policy API across SDKs - [x] Implement centralized auth refresh interface in all SDKs - [x] Streaming ergonomics: chunked events + on_backpressure hook - [x] Parity fixes: error codes, metadata headers, streaming close reasons - [x] Tests added for Python/TS/Go - [x] Bump versions to v1.193.0 and update changelogs Related: Linear ENG-3421, ENG-3497. See design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-3421/sdk-auth-retries-streaming-unification. Notes on rollout: published canary packages for TS/Python and canary Docker image for Go; rolled out to internal integration tests before merge.

release_notes: - Unify auth token refresh and retry policy across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. - Improved streaming ergonomics: chunked events API, reconnect/backpressure hooks. - Parity fixes for error wrapping and metadata propagation. - SDK versions bumped to v1.193.0.
